title: Kesha Code LLM
summary: On-device LLM that writes & runs scripts, with chat and camera recognition
description:
Kesha Code LLM runs small language models entirely on the M5Stack Cardputer Zero with llama.cpp — no account, no cloud.

Code: each project has a file manager, a tiny sh/Python editor and a console. A local model writes, names and edits scripts for you from the project chat, using built-in skills for common tasks (wifi, web server, Python snippets, battery and more). Pick the model per task: a 90M for speed, a 350M for better code, or a 0.5B coder to leave thinking.

Power mode frees RAM so the bigger models fit (it lowers gpu_mem and turns the camera off; reversible, needs a restart).

Chat: talk to a small model offline.
Vision: live object detection (YOLOX) with boxes and percentages, text recognition (OCR), photos and annotated video.
Models: download, switch and delete models, or drop in your own .gguf / .onnx files.

Always review a script before you run it.
